notes: Every number and quoted record text of the record page (record.md), with the record field that holds it, in lane F's format (fleetlab.film.fields). Fields of the record 'derived' read derived.json, which python -m fleetlab.film.record computes from the 'derived' section below (proportions with Wilson intervals, rescued and broken recounted from a receipt's pairs, counts and selections); lane F's loader reads only 'fields', so that section is additive. Story B's linked site is read from each fleet's public description (the site whose note names the customer's data centre). 'forbidden' lists what the bound page must never show (hidden world ids, design and truth files); binding refuses a page that shows one. 'action_words' puts adopted and tested actions in plain words.
